text: SHARE2 landed: GET /v1/datasets/{d}/releases/{r}/archive streams a release as an uncompressed zip, rechecking authority every 64 KiB as single-file reads do. SHARE2's throughput criterion (a release of at least 5 GiB with a file over 1 GiB, 20 MB per second or better) was not measured there and is carried here, with CORE4 as the remedy if it misses. Measure it on an organization-enabled catalog, where each check loads the policy; the legacy catalog path is not representative.
